summary.text: Hai Pham is a Democratic state representative from District 36 who has represented the district since January 9, 2023 and is seeking re-election.

paragraphs.text: Hai Pham earned graduate degrees from Oregon Health & Science University in 2006 and 2009 and a bachelor's degree from Oregon State University in 2022.
His career experience includes work as a dentist.
